name_rule: Viet 'Viindoo' (chu V hoa, hai chu i thuong, roi 'ndoo'); khong VIINDOO, khong viindoo, khong ViiNdoo

color_roles.primary: Mau chinh - cyan; nut chinh, highlight, link
color_roles.secondary: Mau thu cap - tim; logo, action phu
color_roles.danger: Trang thai loi (LUU Y: hex trang khong publish ro - gia tri nay can xac minh lai voi brand team)

admin_legal.basis: Nghi dinh 30/2020/ND-CP (the thuc van ban hanh chinh VN)
admin_legal.heading: UPPERCASE, bold, 13-14pt

typography.rule: Khong dung font ngoai danh sach. Ngoai le: van ban chinh phu bat buoc, hoac form ben thu ba khoa format.

logo.note: logo-color.svg = ban MAU CHUAN (Viin #00BBCE + doo #7F4282), dung tren nen trang/sang; tren anh/nen toi thi dat len the trang. Cung duong net voi logo-inverted.svg, chi doi mau trang -> #00BBCE; da doi chieu voi logo-no-slogan-1.webp (10/10/2026). logo-inverted.svg KHONG phai logo trang toan phan: Viin trang + doo tim #7F4282, CHI dung tren nen cyan phang #00BBCE (tren nen toi phan doo tim bi chim). Ban trang toan phan cho nen toi chua co file - tai tu Google Drive (source_urls) hoac hoi brand team.
